Register the dsprrr engine with parsnip

Source: R/parsnip.R
register_dsprrr_engine.Rd

register_dsprrr_engine() registers the llm_predict model and its "dsprrr" engine with parsnip. dsprrr calls it automatically when parsnip is loaded, so you rarely need it. It does nothing when parsnip is not installed or the model is already registered.

Usage

register_dsprrr_engine()

Value

NULL, invisibly.

See also

Other integrations: as_dsprrr_metric(), as_dsprrr_traces(), as_ellmer_tool(), as_vitals_cost(), as_vitals_samples(), as_vitals_solver(), as_vitals_task(), create_search_tool(), llm_predict(), ragnar_tool(), reasoning_effort(), summarize_traces_df(), temperature(), top_p(), use_dsprrr_template(), validate_workflow(), vitals_metrics

Examples

register_dsprrr_engine()
parsnip::show_engines("llm_predict")
#> # A tibble: 2 × 2
#>   engine mode          
#>   <chr>  <chr>         
#> 1 dsprrr classification
#> 2 dsprrr regression
